description: This file defines the SaveLeaveTypeController class which extends an abstract Vue controller, managing the pre-render logic for leave type forms in the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It dynamically sets Vue components and properties based on request attributes.

classes.name: SaveLeaveTypeController
classes.description: Controller class handling pre-render setup for leave type forms, determining whether to load an edit or save component based on request parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Sets up the Vue component for leave type creation or editing, depending on the presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.
